desc: Wet carpet beast: a yellow-brown carpet blob body with fringe tassels as legs, gold drain-grate armor on its back, a black void face with wide mischievous eyes and a toothy grin. Living Backrooms creature, cute chibi but cool, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no shadow. Yellow wallpaper, cardboard brown, lavender, gold palette.
